name: Guide
summary: A wilderness leader who focuses on the foe at hand, shares terrain expertise, and turns luck and inspiration into decisive action.

features.name: Ranger's Focus
features.summary: Focus on one visible enemy to gain +2 on attack and damage rolls against it.
features.scaling: +2 every 5 Ranger levels; +1 daily use at 4th and every 3 levels

features.name: Terrain Bond
features.summary: In favored terrain, grant nearby allies +2 initiative and bonuses on Perception, Stealth, and Survival, and let them travel without a trail.

features.name: Ranger's Luck
features.summary: Reroll one attack or force an enemy who hit you to reroll its attack.
features.scaling: one additional daily use at 14th and 19th

features.name: Inspired Moment
features.summary: Until the end of your next turn, gain speed, an extra move or swift action, +4 to key checks and attacks, and automatic critical confirmations.

features.name: Improved Ranger's Luck
features.summary: Gain +4 on your Ranger's Luck rerolls or impose –4 on the enemy reroll, including critical confirmation rolls.
